questions.q: What is the first step toward a meaningful conversation?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says meaningful dialogue starts with listening and putting yourself in the other's shoes.

questions.q: What should you avoid doing when someone approaches you angry?
a: Meeting them with anger and defensiveness
questions.why: Lesson 1 says defensiveness escalates conflict; calm empathy reduces tension instead.

questions.q: What does the summary say about your own perspective in a conflict?
a: It is not the absolute truth
questions.why: Lesson 2 says we treat our view as objective truth, but it is only one perspective.

questions.q: How can you help someone feel acknowledged?
a: Explain why their feelings are wrong
questions.why: Lesson 3 says validation works even when you disagree, and advice can feel intrusive.

a: Only when the person asks for it
questions.why: Lesson 3 says offering advice unasked can intrude on the other person's space.
